argv: $p=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter 'ProcessId = 60952'; if (-not $p) { throw 'Owned process is gone' }; [ordered]@{pid=$p.ProcessId; parent_pid=$p.ParentProcessId; creation_time=$p.CreationDate.ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'); executable=$p.ExecutablePath; command_line=$p.CommandLine; listeners=@(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -OwningProcess 60952 -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess)} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
